notes:
Upright handwritten subject notes continuing a sentence from the preceding sheet and ending mid-phrase du fibré en. There are nineteen prose baselines and one displayed coincidence equation, for twenty main baselines; the small lower-left folio 85 is excluded from that count. No top author page number, diagram, or drawing occurs. The composite E_K to E_{U_eta} to E_U is written on the same baseline as le composé and is not a separate manuscript display. The first opening relation has two very short faint horizontal bars with dark right ends, so its colon-like appearance is retained as an equals sign; the set-difference slash is oblique. The large I in section de T sur I has both a top and bottom serif and is preserved as I, without changing it to S. The opening g_i=g_{i_0}, the later g_{i_0}, and the displayed g_i(s)=f(s) retain their different written indices. The car-like deletion and the lighter S/s beneath the dark replacement K remain doubtful. The struck nulle is confined to that word; triviale is live. The single f before de U has a normal crossbar, without a second deleted f. The parentheses around the inertia-image remark and the reference to (7) are retained as written. The quoted expression has raised double quotation marks, and the final O symbol has its own underline. The author says on l'a vu, refers to suite exacte (7) while explicitly saying the notations were changed, specifies pas strict, and then qualifies the description with ou mieux. These cautions and references are transcribed, not independently verified here. The second connector is a plain shaft with no distinct angled head, confirmed by comparison with the explicitly headed first arrow. No arrowhead is supplied from the word composé. No mathematical proof or factual cross-page check was performed, and check_events is therefore empty. The supplied marks list contains only M1236; the nested C doubts in deleted car. and S|s were also cropped and remain in the draft.

Blind adjudication: the opening definition sign has two extremely short, partly faded horizontal traces with dark right ends; retain = first but mark colon as an alternative. The nested generic-fibre index is K after comparison of its short branched foot with 088/090/093/096 and the longer eta return on 102; the mathematics identifies the notation but does not supply a missing stroke. The written même short form is =, not barred m. The final phrase remains fibré en, with a tall f, looped b and accented e, not générique. All ten token-different boxes were inspected.
